text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-, six- and nine-month treasury bills on February 11 were mixed, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills fell to 30.10 percent from 32.29 percent, six-month bills rose to 37.58 percent from 35.67 percent and nine-month bills edged up to 39.80 from 36.36 percent from the last sale on February 6.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15 million hryvnia 15 million hryvnia
Amount sold 9.80 million UAH 7.93 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.12 million UAH 7.34 million UAH
The central bank sold 98,013 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 24,085 were competitive and 73,928 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 13.
The results of Tuesday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 17 million hryvnia 17 million hryvnia
Amount sold 9.38 million UAH 16.05 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.89 million UAH 13.63 million UAH
The central bank sold 93,794 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 8,800 were competitive and 84,994 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 13.
The results of Tuesday's auction of nine-month discount T-bills were as follows:
Issue volume 20 million hryvnia 20 million hsyvnia
Amount sold 4.43 million UAH 19.22 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.41 million UAH 15.11 million UAH
The central bank sold 44,263 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 27,116 were competitive and 17,147 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 13.
The auction of 12-month treasury bills scheduled for February 11 was cancelled, a central bank statement said.
